item.title: Zuby Ejiofor: The Surprising No. 23 Pick Powering Atlanta's Future
item.description:
What does it take to go from a barely used freshman who got hauled out of his apartment in a U-Haul to a first-round NBA Draft pick? Zuby Ejiofor has the answer — and the Atlanta Hawks just bet roughly $17.3 million on it.

On draft night, the Hawks selected the St. John’s forward with the No. 23 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. For a player who wasn’t even invited to the green room, it was a moment three years in the making.

item.title: When Is the NBA Draft? Your 2026 Guide
item.description:
For the second straight year, the answer to “when is the NBA Draft” isn’t a single night — it’s two of them.

The 2026 NBA Draft is here, and the biggest annual event on the basketball calendar will reshape the futures of 60 college players, international prospects, and the franchises betting on them. If you’ve been searching for exact dates, start times, and the prospects most likely to hear their names called first, this is your complete guide.
